name: Slack: Send to Slack
description: Send data to Slack to start a Slack workflow in Workflow Builder, call a Slack API method, or post a message into a channel

api.description: A custom API URL to send Slack API method requests to.

errors.description: If the step exits with an error on errors or continues.

method.description: The Slack API method to call.

payload.description: Attributes that create the content of the request using JSON or YAML.

payload-delimiter.description: Field seperator for nested attributes in the input payload.

payload-file-path.description: Path to a file containing a valid input payload made of JSON or YAML.

payload-templated.description: If templated variables in input payloads should be replaced.

proxy.description: An optional proxied route for HTTPS connections.

retries.description: The strategy to use when performing retried requests.

token.description: The authentication value used with the Slack API.

webhook.description: A location for posting request payloads.

webhook-type.description: Option to use either an incoming webhook or webhook trigger.
